speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have to walk. Not to the Rother end. Farther than the stair, shorter than a boast. How do I mend the walking, if the back will come with me whether I agree or not?

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: You don't mend the back by walking it off. You mend the walking. A stick. To the hip, not the shoulder. The shoulder makes a man lean into a speech. The hip lets him be a man with a pace.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Cut it to the hip, then. I'll use the length you cut, and I will not ask you for a taller one halfway down the street.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Stand as you can. The measure is from the floor to the hollow of the hand, with the arm hung down, not reached up. If you reach, you cheat, and the cheat is a shoulder.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not reaching. Cut it where the hand already is.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: There. That is the hip. Shorter than you want, which is how I know it is right.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It feels short.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: If it feels too short, it is the right length. You will hate it for a street and thank it at the corner. That is the whole lesson, and it does not have a second half.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: He is walking with me, when the light is off the street. He does not need a second half, Richard. He needs the stick and the arm and a pace he will complain about.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Where?

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: You will see it when you are at it. I am not giving you the name in a kitchen, where you can make it into a plan. Bring the stick. Leave the sheets. This is not a day for the girl at the window.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: The six pairs are said for. He has not changed them yet. They are not your walk today, and you are not to limp down and negotiate a skin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not negotiating a skin. Six pairs went with you. The word was mine. The legs were yours. Today is a stick.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Today is a stick and an arm, and a name you do not get in this room. If you ask again before we are at the place, I shall take you back up the stair and call the bargain kept badly.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not ask again in this room.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Hip. Not shoulder. The back comes with you. I am not mending the back. I am mending the walk, and only the length of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The back is not eased. I am not going to call it eased because I have a stick.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Good. The eighteenth is not today. Today is as far as a corner, at a funeral's pace, and then home. You do not pack the sheets to prove you can.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Leave the sheets. Leave the inkhorn. A man with a new stick does not also carry a play, or he is performing the stick.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sheets stay. The inkhorn stays. I am performing nothing.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then sit until the light is off the street. When I come for you, you come, and you do not improve the direction on the way down the stair.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: And if the stick feels wrong at the door, it is still the right stick. You asked how to mend the walking. This is the answer. Follow it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll follow that, and I'll follow her, and I won't improve either of you on the way.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Hip, then. Not a speech about a hip. I will see you when the street is quieter, and not before.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Six pairs stay said for. One stick. One length. I am going back to the shop, where the work does not ask me where it is going.
